baseline.name: MaBaybay Default (First Candidate)
baseline.strategy: Always pick first candidate from transliteration

cosine_only.name: Pure Cosine Similarity (Semantic Only)
cosine_only.strategy: 100% cosine similarity of mean-pooled RoBERTa embeddings, no other features

cosine_multi.name: Cosine Similarity + Multi-Feature (Old Method)
cosine_multi.strategy: Cosine similarity semantic + frequency + cooccurrence + morphology

mlm_multi.name: MLM PLL + Multi-Feature (Current)
mlm_multi.strategy: MLM pseudo-log-likelihood semantic + frequency + cooccurrence + morphology
